Definition: from G2532 and G1065; and at least (or even, indeed):--and, at least.
BiblicalUsage: Kaige is 'and at least' or 'and even' — the compound of 'and' and the little particle 'indeed.' It stands at the head of the promise that God will pour out His Spirit upon His servants and handmaidens, and in Paul's word that men might feel after God, though He be not far from every one of us.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this small word carries a large mercy: God is not far, His Spirit falls even on servants, and the 'even' is the gospel reaching further than we expect.
RelatedTopics: Presence of God; Outpouring of the Spirit
